about.description:
Apprentice is a tool for the construction of multivariate polynomial and
rational approximations of computationally expensive functions, such as
the per-bin response of Monte Carlo event generators to their parameters,
and for using these surrogate models in the tuning of the parameters
to experimental data.

The Gaussian process module (apprentice.GP) additionally requires GPy and
pandas, available as the 'gp' extra.

name: pyapprentice
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.1.0"

package:
  name: pyapprentice
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  # upstream does not tag releases on GitHub past v1.0.6, so use the PyPI sdist
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/pyapprentice/pyapprentice-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: c35aa0b6175579290fd6d44ce73d89756a41c480b32255dc286afc192e3baf4c
    patches:
      # 'sklearn' is the deprecated PyPI alias of scikit-learn and breaks pip
      # check. Already fixed upstream in HEPonHPC/apprentice@391c58b (PR #15,
      # merged 2024-05-07); the 1.1.0 sdist predates it, so backport it here.
      - use-scikit-learn-distribution-name.patch
      # 'scripts' in setup.py installs extensionless shebang scripts that are
      # not executable on Windows, so use console_scripts entry points instead.
      # Still 'scripts' on upstream master; not submitted upstream yet.
      - use-console-scripts-entry-points.patch
      # __init__.py prints to stdout when the optional GP module is missing,
      # which corrupts the output of every app-* tool now that GPy is an extra.
      # Not submitted upstream yet.
      - warn-instead-of-print-when-gp-unavailable.patch
      # "\[" in GP.py and "\l" in testData.py are invalid escape sequences, which
      # raise a SyntaxWarning on first import (when the .py files are compiled)
      # and will become a SyntaxError in a future Python. Still present on
      # upstream master; not submitted upstream yet.
      - fix-invalid-escape-sequences.patch
  # neither PDF is in the sdist, so fetch both from the repo at the pinned commit
  - url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HEPonHPC/apprentice/e48ab1d512784452560e56f70dfc66dc365e9184/LICENSE_SF-19-096_apprentice_GPL_3.0.pdf
    sha256: 7a331cfb587c14566472bff52add99f57020393df7b9cdca027f948cc7a232e3
  - url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HEPonHPC/apprentice/e48ab1d512784452560e56f70dfc66dc365e9184/LICENSE.pdf
    sha256: a3d1aa5dede4395e9df0495585df1adf3deaa55b07e3addb77884b5991b0a19d

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - app-ls = apprentice._cli:app_ls
      - app-tune2 = apprentice._cli:app_tune2
      - app-build = apprentice._cli:app_build
      - app-predict = apprentice._cli:app_predict
      - app-datadirtojson = apprentice._cli:app_datadirtojson
      - app-yoda2h5 = apprentice._cli:app_yoda2h5
      - app-yodaenvelope = apprentice._cli:app_yodaenvelope
      - app-sample = apprentice._cli:app_sample
      - extrema.py = apprentice._cli:extrema

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=1.15.0
    - scipy >=1.7.2
    - scikit-learn
    - matplotlib-base >=3.0.0
    - pydoe2 >=1.3.0
    # Not in the sdist's install_requires, but used for JIT acceleration and
    # required by the app-* command line tools for HDF5 I/O. mpi4py is imported
    # unconditionally by etc/extrema.py, so it cannot move to an extra.
    - numba >=0.40.0
    - h5py >=2.8.0
    - mpi4py >=3.0.0
    # The yoda-reading paths in apprentice.io and app-tune2/app-yoda2h5/
    # app-yodaenvelope need yoda, which has no win-64 build, so it would make
    # this noarch package uninstallable on Windows. Left to the user to install.
  extras:
    # apprentice.GP is guarded by a try/except ImportError in __init__.py, so
    # these are genuinely optional. gpy has no linux-aarch64 or linux-ppc64le
    # build, and requiring it would make this noarch package unsolvable there.
    # gpy 1.13.1 carries no upper bound on matplotlib-base but breaks on >=3.9,
    # so exclude it.
    gp:
      - gpy >=1.13.2
      - pandas >=1.3.4

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - apprentice
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"

  - files:
      recipe:
        - test_approximation.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - gpy
        - pandas
    script:
      - app-build --help
      - app-tune2 --help
      - app-predict --help
      - app-ls --help
      - app-sample --help
      - app-datadirtojson --help
      - app-yoda2h5 --help
      - app-yodaenvelope --help
      - extrema.py --help

      - python ./test_approximation.py

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/HEPonHPC/apprentice
  summary: Multivariate surrogate modelling and Monte Carlo event generator tuning
  description: |
    Apprentice is a tool for the construction of multivariate polynomial and
    rational approximations of computationally expensive functions, such as
    the per-bin response of Monte Carlo event generators to their parameters,
    and for using these surrogate models in the tuning of the parameters
    to experimental data.

    The Gaussian process module (apprentice.GP) additionally requires GPy and
    pandas, available as the 'gp' extra.
  license: BSD-3-Clause AND GPL-3.0-only
  # LICENSE.pdf is a further GPL-2.0 grant from UChicago Argonne naming
  # apprentice; it is not mentioned in the README, which states only the
  # Fermilab BSD and GPL-3.0 terms reflected in the license expression above.
  # Shipped so no license text is dropped -- worth confirming with upstream
  # whether the expression should also cover it.
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - LICENSE_SF-19-096_apprentice_GPL_3.0.pdf
    - LICENSE.pdf
  repository: https://github.com/HEPonHPC/apprentice

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - matthewfeickert
